Despite some fluctuations in demand, the business maintained healthy margins, with cost controls and efficiency measures helping to offset any increase in operational expenses. As a result, gross profit grew at a stable rate, keeping in line with management’s expectations. Net income also rose, bolstered by favorable tax conditions and reduced interest expenses due to a restructuring of long-term debt.
